name: Frühstückspension Gmünderklause
beschreibung:
Gmuenderklause in Gerlos impresses with its friendly ambiance and prime setting for mountain walkers and winter sports lovers. A generous breakfast buffet fuels energizing days outdoors.

Side valley trails around Gerlos and the lifts of the Zillertal Arena are located nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Fruehstueckspension Gmuenderklause in Gerlos provides alpine warmth in the heart of the Zillertal Arena.
